verses.1: In the year of King Uzziah’s death, I will see Adonai sitting on his high throne. His clothes will be filled with dust.
verses.2: There are flames standing above him; six wings like wings. In two places, they cover his face; in two other places, they cover his legs. And in two more places, they cover his body entirely.
verses.3: And they called out to each other, saying, “Holy, holy, holy is the Lord God, the Almighty! He fills all the earth with His glory!”
verses.4: And the voices of the singers faded away from the sound of the singer’s voice, and the house was filled with smoke.
verses.5: And he said, “Oh, for pity on me! It seems to me that I am like a man with dirty feet. I sit among a people with dirty feet. I serve the king Jehovah’s army. My eyes have seen it.”
verses.6: And one of the flames flew towards me. In his hand, he held a brush, and he took something from the altar.
verses.7: And it touched your lips, and he said, “Now, this has touched your lips. May your sins be forgiven.”
verses.8: And I heard the voice of my Lord saying, “Who shall I send? Who will go to us?” And He said, “I will send you.”
verses.9: And he said, “Tell this people, ‘Hear what they say, but do not understand it. See what they see, but do not comprehend it.’”
verses.10: May the heart of this people be healed, and may their ears be sensitive. May they hear with their ears, understand with their hearts, and be healed.
verses.11: And he said, “Until my death.” And Adonai said, “Until when? Until cities are left without inhabitants, and houses without people. Then the land will be desolate.”
verses.12: And Jehovah separated the man from the woman; and great was the separation in the midst of the earth.
verses.13: And there were also twelve of them. They returned, and they became like those seeds of the Holy Seed that were planted in them.
